brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu said his address to the UN General Assembly will contain surprises, according to Al Jazeera English. The Israeli prime minister did not specify what those surprises would entail or when the speech would take place.

Netanyahu has appeared before the General Assembly multiple times throughout his political career, using the platform to outline Israeli positions on regional security and international affairs.
dek: Benjamin Netanyahu says there will be surprises in his UN General Assembly address.
title: Netanyahu promises surprises in UN General Assembly speech
